titulo: AI communication hub with human approval
contexto: Conversations, requests and agreements from an entire messaging channel were stuck in the chat history, with no triage, no record and no way to find the context of an old decision.
atuacao: Messages collected into a dedicated store, contextual history, triage with filters and tags, search for tasks and pending items, AI-suggested replies and manual approval before anything is sent.
resultado: Communication organized in a single dashboard, with context that can be found and nothing sent without human confirmation.

contexto: Decisions and identifiers shown in different systems, with no integration between them, had to be compared quickly to catch discrepancies.
atuacao: Screen content captured with OCR, identifiers normalized and compared against rules, and inconsistencies flagged while the work is happening.
resultado: Faster verification and an objective layer of checking, with discrepancy types classified to cut false alarms.

contexto: The operation needed to size its team in line with real demand, without relying only on gut feeling or a simple average.
atuacao: Analysis of months of volume by day and by hour, handling of atypical days, calculation of each slot’s weight, forecasting, sizing and schedule validation.
resultado: Planning that can be justified and repeated, with forecast, capacity and schedule kept separate and the criteria documented.

titulo: Analysis of overtime and payroll components
contexto: The origin of a consolidated overtime total had to be explained, and the amounts then broken down by person.
atuacao: The total rebuilt from the individual entries, each component validated and the amounts distributed by employee in order of impact.
resultado: An aggregate number turned into an auditable analysis, traceable from the grand total to pay items and individuals.

titulo: Audit and reconciliation of people databases
contexto: Two operational databases differed in names and in which records were present, and there was no way to confirm that everyone was on both sides.
atuacao: A full comparison of the lists, data normalization, exact and fuzzy name matching, and an audit file as the output.
resultado: Real differences separated from spelling variations, less manual checking and a reusable basis for future audits.

contexto: Accounts and permissions needed a review to reduce unnecessary access and operational risk.
atuacao: An inventory of users, groups, permissions and usage, identification of inactive accounts and criteria for removal and review.
resultado: Less exposure to stale access and a more controlled offboarding process, with the repetitive steps automated.

contexto: A leadership report assembled by hand every month, with numbers of untraceable origin and deviations noticed only after the month had closed.
atuacao: An Excel model with 9 source tables, an isolated calculation engine, 16 automatic alert rules and 11 reconciliation checks, feeding 12 report pages from a single control cell.
resultado: No number typed in by hand: changing the reference month updates the entire report, and any leadership metric can be traced back to its source table.

contexto: Following several technology areas by hand meant too many sources and the risk of missing relevant updates.
atuacao: A pipeline for collection, deduplication, classification, embeddings and relevance scoring, with daily and weekly reports written by a local model.
resultado: Scattered monitoring turned into a structured technical intelligence process, isolated and validated before running on its own.

titulo: Publishing with Git, a test environment and a custom domain
contexto: A website had to be developed and published safely, keeping every version and with no direct changes in production.
atuacao: A repository with branches, pull requests, a test environment, static publishing and domain setup through DNS.
resultado: Development, validation and production kept separate, with a change history and the ability to roll back.

titulo: Technical SEO, semantics and accessibility audit
contexto: A website had to be prepared for launch with better indexing, semantic structure and technical consistency.
atuacao: Review of headings, metadata, robots.txt, sitemap, Search Console, indexability, alt text and semantic elements.
resultado: Lower technical indexing risk, a better structure for search engines and assistive technologies, and a reusable launch checklist.
